name: Fashion Editorial Lookbook
tagline: A complete 22-slide photographic lookbook with source Fogtwo No5 and Inter, circular crops, black editorial spreads, fine line patterns and native fashion credits.

palette.description: Exact source warm light gray with black editorial spreads and white paper notes; the clothing and landscape photographs provide the muted natural tones.

typography.style: Exact source Fogtwo No5 400 and Inter 400/700 embedded unchanged, plus source Nunito Sans 400 (under its original UUID family alias) for six small credit numerals. Original 1920×1080 high-contrast serif frames, rotated captions, line heights and letter spacing are retained.

best_for: Fashion and photography editorials that need complete visual-story sequences, circular and capsule crops, paired detail images, pattern layers, clothing credits and a native team-credit spread.
avoid_for: Dense business reporting, chart-heavy research, formal board materials or decks whose story depends on many paragraphs on every page.

source_inspiration.name: Carmen Nácher — Editorial Layouts (Pitch), complete 22-page public sequence
source_inspiration.notes: Complete public source sequence rebuilt from measured DOM and all computed style values. Text, SVG primitives, rules, processes, pricing and captions remain native and replaceable; photographs and any source line textures remain independent embedded image slots. Exact loaded source image bytes and source font faces are embedded for offline display. Long prose is original demonstration writing of similar length, recorded in the evidence manifest; short labels and sample names do not imply endorsement. Several pages are layout variants rather than unique layouts. Source design and individual media redistribution rights have not been fully confirmed; this is not a grant of those rights.
